body.name: Guidon Bearer
body.notes: Carrying the guidon of a unit, always marching in front, is not only an honour but also comes with great responsibility. Guidon bearers wield great power, they lead where others follow and keep the spirits of the troops up as they wave their flag against the golden suns of Tibia.

body.name: Festive
body.notes: This outfit was implemented with the [[Updates/11.02|Winter Update 2016]], but was only released after the start of [[Tibia's 20th Anniversary]] celebrations.

body.addons: [[Premium Account]], see [[Citizen of Issavi Outfits Quest]]
body.history: A version of these outfits which is used only by NPCs and creatures such as [[Black Sphinx Acolyte]] and [[Priestess of the Wild Sun]] was implemented with the [[Updates/12.20|Summer Update 2019]].
body.name: Citizen of Issavi
Recruiter
body.notes:
The outfit was added as part of a promotion by CipSoft. You can obtain it as a reward if one of your friends invited by you via [https://www.tibia.com/account/?subtopic=accountmanagement&page=invitefriend Invite New Players] feature buys something in the [[Store]]. If three of your invited friends buy a product in the Store, you will receive the First Addon, if ten of your invited friends buy a product in the Store, you will receive the Second Addon. The outfit and addons will be available to all characters on your account, you don't have to assign them to a specific character.
Upon earning the full outfit, players used to earn the [[achievement]] [[The More the Merrier]]. However, this achievement was removed from the game. ''Full Walking Animations from the [https://www.tibia.com/account/?subtopic=accountmanagement&page=invitefriend&step=showrewards Reward Page]:'' Recruiter_Outfit.gif|Base Outfit Recruiter_Outfit_with_Addon_1.gif|First Addon Full_Recruiter_Outfit.gif|Full Outfit

body.name: Summoner
body.notes: Great for young mages and ladies who love witchcraft. If you are looking to earn addons, gentlemen should take a stroll in [[Port Hope]], whereas ladies should explore the [[Dark Cathedral]].

body.name: Royal Costume
body.notes:
Unlike other quest outfits, these outfits can be obtained and worn by [[Free Account]] players.

You can see the players who own the Royal Costume Outfit in a given server by checking a [[Memorial]].

body.name: Breezy Garb
body.notes: Even the most eager adventurers and toughest warriors need some time to rest and recharge. Enjoy tranquility and peace as you picnic in good company at one of your favourite places in Tibia. Put on your Breezy Garb outfit, grab your walking stick, a basket filled with tasty snacks and then head out into nature!

body.name: Formal Dress
body.outfit: [[Premium Account]], see [[25 Years of Tibia Quest]]

body.name: Aerial Disciple
body.notes: With wings borne on discipline and faith, the Aerial Disciple walks the path of stillness and steel. Serene in spirit, lethal in combat, this warrior is a storm held in perfect control.

body.name: Norseman
body.notes: Norseman and norsewoman outfits had been made especially for frozen areas.

body.history: These outfits were added to the [[Store]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|3783|November 18, 2016}}, but they were implemented a few weeks earlier on October 25, 2016 with [[Updates/11.01.3987|11.01.3987]] and [[Updates/10.99|10.99]].
body.name: Grove Keeper
body.notes: Feeling the springy grass under your feet and inhaling the spicy air of the forest is pure satisfaction for your soul? Every animal is your friend and you caringly look after trees and plants all the time? Then it is time to become one with nature: Become a Grove Keeper!

body.name: Phoenix Evoker
body.notes:
The Phoenix Evoker commands the essence of fire itself. A living embodiment of renewal and ruin. His magic sweeps across the battlefield in waves of heat and brilliance, leaving both awe and fear in its wake. Embers obey his call, ash is his canvas. Through flame, he brings both destruction and rebirth.

Purchasing this [[Outfits|Outfit]] through the [[Burning Ash Bundle]] can save you 360 [[Tibia Coins]] instead of buying each of the items separately.

body.history: This outfit was added to the [[Store]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|6661|April 08, 2022}}.
body.name: Nordic Chieftain
body.notes: Where others not dare to tread due to the biting cold and freezing winds, the Nordic Chieftain feels right at home. Braving the harsh conditions is possible due to a protective layer of warm clothing, as well as suitable armament to fend off any hostile wildlife. The helmet's massive horns are a tad heavy and unwieldy, but show the chieftain's status.

body.history: This outfit was added to the [[Store]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|7731|February 23, 2024}}.
body.name: Celestial Avenger
body.notes: For those who have been touched by the gods, their devotion and belief infuse their very being, transforming them into beacons of divine light. The Celestial Avenger outfit is a testament to this divine power, adorned with shimmering angelic wings that radiate an ethereal glow. This outfit is not just for show - it is a symbol of unwavering faith and an embodiment of the divine power that resides within its wearer. Execute divine justice, follow your devotion and belief, and become the Celestial Avenger!

body.name: Draccoon Herald
body.outfit: [[Premium Account]], see [[20 Years a Cook Quest]]

body.name: Trailblazer
body.notes: The Trailblazer is on a mission of enlightenment and carries the flame of wisdom near and far. The everlasting shine brightens the hearts and minds of all creatures its rays touch, bringing light even to the darkest corners of the world as a beacon of insight and knowledge.

body.name: Bat Knight
body.notes: Born from the depths of darkness, he wields a merciless sword and dons the armor of conquest. The Bat Knight is a nocturnal terror, forged from the most wicked of nightmares. Has his deadly blade never haunted your sleep?

body.name: Jester
body.notes: Jester outfits are a new design for jokers.

body.name: Mercenary
body.notes: These outfits were added to the [[Store]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|4506|Abril 13, 2018}}, but they were already implemented a few weeks earlier with [[Updates/11.00#11.72.6598|Update 11.72]].

body.history: The outfit was added as part of a promotion by [[CipSoft]]. You can buy the outfit with no addons, one addon or the full outfit from the official Tibia website. The outfit and its addons are otherwise unobtainable in-game.
body.name: Conjurer
body.notes:
You recently graduated from the Magic Academy and want to bring your knowledge to good use? Congratulations, you are now an honourable disciple of magic! Open up a bottle of well-aged mana and treat yourself with the fashionable Conjurer outfit.
Conjurer_Outfit.gif|Base Outfit Conjurer_Outfit_with_Addon_1.gif|First Addon Conjurer_Outfit_with_Addon_2.gif|Second Addon Full_Conjurer_Outfit.gif|Full Outfit

body.history: It was added to the [[Store]] on December 23, 2015.
body.name: Winter Warden
body.notes: The warm and cosy cloak of the Winter Warden outfit will keep you warm in every situation. Best thing, it is not only comfortable but fashionable as well. You will be the envy of any snow queen or king, guaranteed!

body.name: Hunter
body.notes: This outfit was revamped in [[Updates/7.8|Update 7.8]]. Hunter outfits are light and comfortable for any paladin or ranger.

body.history: Although these outfits were implemented on [[Updates/11.50|Update 11.50]], the achievement was only implemented on [[Updates/11.53|Update 11.53]].
body.name: Makeshift Warrior

body.history: These outfits were added to the [[Store]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|4480|February 16, 2018}}, but they were already implemented a few months earlier with [[Updates/11.49.6030|Update 11.49.6030]].
body.name: Siege Master
body.notes: Neither thick stone walls nor heavily armoured gates can stop the Siege Master, who brings down hostile fortifications in the blink of an eye. Whenever he tenses his muscular arms to lift the powerful battering ram, his enemies' knees begin to buckle. It is the perfect outfit for those who also stand for brute strength and immense destruction.

body.name: Warrior
body.notes: The lighter version of the knight outfit is great if you want to save stamina and maintain agility. Addons are usually awarded by knight guilds.

body.name: Mage
body.notes: This outfit was revamped in [[Updates/7.8|Update 7.8]]. Mage outfits are intriguing and dangerous. Perfect for the wise and enchanting magic user.

body.history: It only became possible to obtain the second addon of this outfit with the release of the [[Summer Update 2022]], when the 20th area of Tibia, [[Marapur]], was implemented.
body.name: Discoverer

body.history:
This outfit was added to the [[Store]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|7423|July 28, 2023}}.
[[File:Flamefury Mage Outfits.jpg]]
body.name: Flamefury Mage
body.notes: Flame fury mages not only embraced the fury to fire, they became it! Relishing in purging destruction they don't just want to see the world burn, but be an active part in it. They just love the smell of sulphur in the morning!

body.name: Nobleman
body.notes: Nobleman and noblewoman outfits are a great way to show your status as a wealthy individual. Only the most wealthy and refined individuals will be seen in these threads.

body.history: These outfits were added to the [[Store]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|4754|October 19, 2018}}, but they were already implemented 10 days earlier with [[Updates/11.92.7441|Update 11.92]].
body.name: Pumpkin Mummy
body.notes: If you cannot decide whether to wrap yourself up as a mummy or flaunt an enormous pumpkin head for your next hunting party, why not combine both? The Pumpkin Mummy outfit is the perfect costume for scary nights and spooky days.

body.history: The outfit was added as part of a promotion by [[CipSoft]]. You can buy the outfit with no addons, one addon or the full outfit from the official Tibia website. The outfit and its addons are otherwise unobtainable in-game.
body.name: Sea Dog
body.notes: Ahoy mateys! Flaunt the swashbuckling Sea Dog outfit and strike a pose with your hook to impress both landlubbers and fellow pirates. Board your next ship in style!

body.name: Beekeeper
body.notes: Can also be obtained by opening a {{Ilink|Sweet Present}} [[Sweet Present]], which also includes the [[Bumblebee]] mount, [[Beehive]], and [[Candy Chest]].

body.name: Feral Trapper
body.notes: The base Feral Trapper Outfit is obtained by trading '''100,000''' {{Icon|Hunting Task Points}} Hunting Task Points (HTP) within the [[Task Board|Hunting Task Shop]]. Additionally, each addon can be obtained by trading '''35,000''' {{Icon|Hunting Task Points}}. Therefore, the full outfits are only obtained after trading the total sum of '''170,000''' {{Icon|Hunting Task Points}}.

body.history: These outfits were added to the [[Store]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|4663|July 13, 2018}}, but they were implemented 3 days earlier with [[Updates/11.00#11.81.7107|Update 11.81]].
body.name: Sinister Archer
body.notes: From an early age, the Sinister Archer has been fascinated by people's dark machinations and perversions. Sinister Archers claim that they advocate the good and that they only use their arrows to pierce the hearts of those who have committed many crimes and misdeeds. However, they are still viewed by the public with much suspicion due to their dubious appearance. To keep their identity secret, they often hide themselves behind a skull-like face guard that can easily withstand even axe and club blows.

body.history:
They were first available during the World Cup of 2014 for {{OfficialNewsArchive|2778|4 weeks}} and for {{OfficialNewsArchive|2823|another week in July 2014}} to celebrate Germany's victory.
They were available for the second time during the World Cup of 2018, for 4 weeks starting on {{OfficialNewsArchive|4661|June 14, 2018}}.
For the World Cup of 2022, these outfits were available from {{post|39351663|November 15}} till December 18, 2022.
body.name: Jersey
body.notes: These outfits are only available during [[wikipedia:FIFA World Cup|FIFA World Cups]] which makes them the only event outfits and also the only quadrennial event in Tibia. These outfits have no addons and are only available to premium account players.

body.name: Barbarian
body.notes:
This outfit stands for raw power, battle cries and lack of manners. I heard that there are a few barbarians living near Northport. They might just be able to provide fitting addons.
[[File:TibiaSS.jpg|thumb|300px|left|Barbarian Outfit Concept Art]]

body.history: This outfit was added to the [[Store]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|8236|Feb 21, 2025}}.
body.name: Winged Druid
body.notes:
Winged Druids are figures of both grace and menace. Wings that cut through the air like blades and an aura of unshakable determination make them a true force to be reckoned with. Harness the raw fury of nature and unleash its vengeance upon those who threaten it!
[[File:Winged Druid Banner.jpg]]

body.history: It was added to the [[Store]] on October 31, 2015.
body.name: Royal Pumpkin
body.notes: The mutated pumpkin is too weak for your mighty weapons? Time to show that evil vegetable how to scare the living daylight out of people! Put on a scary looking pumpkin on your head and spread terror and fear amongst the Tibian population.

body.history: The outfit was added as part of a promotion by [[CipSoft]]. You can buy the outfit with no addons, one addon or the full outfit from the official Tibia website. The outfit and its addons are otherwise unobtainable in-game.
body.name: Spirit Caller
body.notes:
You are in love with the deep soul of Mother Earth and prefer to walk in the shadows of her wooden children? Choose the Spirit Caller outfit to live in harmony with nature.
''Full Walking Animations from Outfit Shop:'' Spirit_Caller_Outfit.gif|Base Outfit Spirit_Caller_Outfit_with_Addon_1.gif|First Addon Spirit_Caller_Outfit_with_Addon_2.gif|Second Addon Spirit_Caller_Outfit_with_Addon_3.gif|Full Outfit

body.history: This outfit was added to the [[Store]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|8317|April 8, 2025}}.
body.name: Martial Artist
body.notes:
Forged in the crucible of hardship, the Martial Artist stands as a paragon of discipline and unyielding willpower. Wear the attire of those who have mastered both body and mind, channelling the spirit of a monk into your every move.
[[File:Martial Artist Banner.jpg]]

body.history: The outfit was added as part of a promotion by [[CipSoft]] on September 3, 2014. You can buy the outfit with no addons, one addon or the full outfit from the official Tibia website. The outfit and its addons are otherwise unobtainable in-game.
body.name: Champion
body.notes:
Protect your body with heavy armour plates and spiky bones to teach your enemies the meaning of fear! The Champion outfit perfectly suits battle-hardened warriors who rely on their trusty sword and shield.
''Full Walking Animations from Outfit Shop:'' Champion_Outfit.gif|Base Outfit Champion_Outfit_with_Addon_1.gif|First Addon Champion_Outfit_with_Addon_2.gif|Second Addon Full_Champion_Outfit.gif|Full Outfit

body.history: The outfit was added as part of a promotion by [[CipSoft]]. You can buy the outfit with no addons, one addon or the full outfit from the official Tibia website.  The outfit and its addons are otherwise unobtainable in-game.
body.name: Chaos Acolyte
body.notes:
You have always felt like the cat among the pigeons and have a fable for dark magic? The Chaos Acolyte outfit is a perfect way to express your inner nature. Show your commitment for the higher cause and wreak havoc on your enemies in this unique outfit.
''Full Walking Animations from Outfit Shop:'' Chaos_Acolyte_Outfit.gif|Base Outfit Chaos_Acolyte_Outfit_with_Addon_1.gif|First Addon Chaos_Acolyte_Outfit_with_Addon_2.gif|Second Addon Full_Chaos Acolyte_Outfit.gif|Full Outfit

body.name: Wizard
body.notes: Are you feeling evil today? This outfit is fitting for mages pursuing the dark side of sorcery. Shunned by the magic academy of Edron, you might find wizards hiding near Thais.

body.name: Knight
body.notes: This outfit was revamped in [[Updates/7.8|Update 7.8]]. Knight outfits are attractive and strong for fighting difficult enemies.

body.addons: [[Premium Account]], see [[Royal Bounacean Advisor Outfits Quest]]
body.name: Royal Bounacean Advisor
Orcsoberfest Garb
body.notes: The base outfit, first and second addons are obtained by defeating [[King Chuck]] for the first time in your second, fourth and sixth editions of [[Orcsoberfest]], respectively.

body.history: This outfit was added to the [[Store]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|8750|May 08, 2026}}.
body.name: Vampire Noble
body.notes:
The Vampire Noble may appear weak beside a Cyclops, but looks deceive. With ruthless elegance and deadly determination, he brings down even the largest foes, until they are reduced to fragments smaller than himself.
[[File:Vampire Noble Banner.jpg]]

body.addons: [[Premium Account]], see [[Hand of the Inquisition Outfits Quest]]
body.history: This outfit was originally called ''Tomb Assassin'', as seen on the Artwork, most likely because it was going to be related to the [[Kilmaresh Quest]] which was released on the same update. When the update was released, however, the outfit was renamed to Hand of the Inquisition, probably to match its final method of obtainment which is not related to Kilmaresh.
body.name: Hand of the Inquisition
Moth Cape
body.notes: If you are fascinated by this particular group of insects and want to show your deep appreciation of these critters, the Moth Cape is for you. The wing-shaped coat and the antennae provide you with the feeling of being a moth without experiencing the downside of inevitably being drawn to light.

body.history: The outfit was added as part of a promotion by [[CipSoft]]. You can buy the outfit with no addons, one addon or the full outfit from the official Tibia website. The outfit and its addons are otherwise unobtainable in-game.
body.name: Ranger
body.notes:
Most of the day, the Ranger is looking over his forest. He is taking care of all animals and plants and tries to keep everything in balance. Intruders are greeted by a warning shot from his deadly longbow. It is the perfect outfit for Paladins who live in close touch with nature.
''Full Walking Animations from Outfit Shop:'' Ranger_Outfit.gif|Base Outfit Ranger_Outfit_with_Addon_1.gif|First Addon Ranger_Outfit_with_Addon_2.gif|Second Addon Full_Ranger_Outfit.gif|Full Outfit

body.history: These outfits were added to the [[Store]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|4069|May 12, 2017}}, but the sprites had already been released with [[Updates/11.30|Update 11.30]].
body.name: Retro Citizen
body.notes: Do you still remember your first stroll through the streets of Thais? For old times' sake, walk the paths of Nostalgia as a Retro Citizen!

body.name: Assassin
body.notes: Assassin outfits are designed for stealth and speed.

body.history: This outfit was added to the [[Store]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|7563|December 22, 2023}}.
body.name: Doom Knight
body.notes:
The Doom Knight, a silent and shrouded entity, embarked on a relentless odyssey, journeying through every valley on the other side and venturing into uncharted realms beyond. The passage of time has rendered this deadly figure unshakeable, an embodiment of unwavering determination in the face of all challenges.
[[File:Doom_Knight_Outfits.png]]

body.history: These outfits were added to the [[Store]] on June 9, 2017, but the sprites were already released a few weeks earlier on April 25, 2017 with [[Updates/11.30|Update 11.30]].
body.name: Trophy Hunter
body.notes: You spend hours in the woods in search of wild and rare animals? Countless stuffed skulls of deer, wolves and other creatures are decorating your walls? Now you have the chance to present your trophies in public. Become a Trophy Hunter and cover your shoulders with the finest bear skulls!

body.history: These outfits were added to the [[Store]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|4093|May 26, 2017}}, but the sprites had already been released with [[Updates/11.30|Update 11.30]].
body.name: Retro Warrior
body.notes: You are fearless and strong as a behemoth but have problems finding the right outfit for your adventures? The Retro Warrior outfit is a must-have for all fashion-conscious old-school Tibians out there.

body.history: This outfit was added to the [[Store]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|8129|Dec 20, 2024}} and was the first implementation from the {{OfficialNewsArchive|7931|Store Ensemble Contest}} which was submitted by {{Character|Skogul The Giant}} who secured the first place in the voting.
body.name: Field Surgeon
body.notes:
This outfit adds a unique flair to your persona. It portrays you as both a healer and a warrior. On one side, you are the hero tending to the injured; on the other, you unleash your bloodthirsty instincts. Enter the fray as a bacteria-free killer, enter the fray as Field Surgeon.
[[File:Field Surgeon Bundle Banner.png]]
Purchasing this [[Outfit]] through the [[Field Surgeon Bundle]] can save you 420 [[Tibia Coins]] instead of buying each of the items separately.

body.name: Merry Garb
body.notes: Are you ready for the festive season? Or feeling festive regardless of the time of year? Then the Merry Garb is perfect for you. Donning the outfit not only puts you in a mirthful mood, but spreads blitheness on your travels throughout the lands.

body.name: Rootwalker
body.notes:
<gallery mode="nolines" widths="568px" heights="692px" hideaddbutton="true" position="center" captionalign="center" style="text-align:center;">
Rootwalker Outfits Artwork.jpg|Official Artwork
</gallery>

body.name: Death Herald
body.notes:
The outfit was added as part of a promotion by [[CipSoft]]. You can buy the outfit with no addons, one addon or the full outfit from the official Tibia website. The outfit and its addons are otherwise unobtainable in-game.

''Full Walking Animations from Outfit Shop:''
<gallery mode="nolines">
Death Herald_Outfit.gif|Base Outfit
Death Herald_Outfit_with_Addon_1.gif|First Addon
Death Herald_Outfit_with_Addon_2.gif|Second Addon
Full_Death Herald_Outfit.gif|Full Outfit
</gallery>

body.name: Owl Keeper
body.notes: Owl Keepers are often referred to as spirits walking through the forest at night, mere shadows during the day. They are also said to be shamans, protecting the flora and fauna of the Tibian lands. You often see them wearing a stag's antlers on their head and in the company of an owl, for they are as wise and mysterious as these intriguing creatures.

body.history: These outfits were added to the [[Store]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|4069|May 12, 2017}}, but the sprites had already been released with [[Updates/11.30|Update 11.30]].
body.name: Retro Hunter
body.notes: Whenever you pick up your bow and spears, you walk down memory lane and think of your early days? Treat yourself with the fashionable Retro Hunter outfit and hunt some good old monsters from your childhood.

body.history: This outfit was added to the [[Store]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|6932|October 14, 2022}}.
body.name: Shadowlotus Disciple
body.notes: The path of the Shadowlotus Disciple is a lonesome and threatening one. Only those who forget their name will learn to sneak within shadows. And only those who will overcome their greatest fear can become a true master of assassination.

body.history: Previously, you used to obtain the complete Falconer Outfit by trading a total of '''170,000''' {{Icon|Hunting Task Points}} Hunting Task Points with [[Walter Jaeger]].
body.name: Falconer
body.notes: The base Falconer Outfit is obtained by trading '''100,000''' {{Icon|Hunting Task Points}} Hunting Task Points (HTP) within the [[Task Board|Hunting Task Shop]]. Additionally, each addon can be obtained by trading '''35,000''' {{Icon|Hunting Task Points}}. Therefore, the full outfits are only obtained after trading the total sum of '''170,000''' {{Icon|Hunting Task Points}}.

body.history: These outfits were added to the [[Store]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|3949|February 17, 2017}}, but the sprites were already released with [[Updates/11.10|Update 11.10]]<!-- or before that -->.
body.name: Pharaoh
body.notes: You know how to read hieroglyphs? You admire the exceptional architectural abilities and the unsolved mysteries of an ancient high culture? Next time you pay a visit to your friends, tell them to prepare a bathtub full of milk and honey for you because a Pharaoh is now walking through the streets of Ankrahmun!

body.name: Pirate
body.notes: Pirate outfits are perfect for swabbing the deck or walking the plank. Quite dashing and great for sailing.

body.name: Percht Raider
body.notes: Players will have to participate a total of three times to unlock the full outfit.

body.history: This outfit was added to the [[Store]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|7123|January 20, 2022}}.
body.name: Frost Tracer
body.notes: Their imposing appearance alone made many experienced warriors shudder. Frost Tracers are true giants that are used to survive even under the most inhospitable circumstances. Tough, strong and untamable, they follow their own path through roughness and obscurity. Nobody wants to mess with one of their kind.

body.name: Nightmare
body.notes: Nightmare Knights outfits are a new design for Lord Protectors.

body.name: Moon Guardian
body.notes: Clad in gleaming moonsilver, the Moon Guardian stands as an unwavering bulwark against the darkness. This celestial sentinel embodies both steadfast defence and mystical power. Whether you protect your allies or strike down your foes, one thing is certain: under the moon's watchful gaze, none shall stand in your way.

body.name: Beggar
body.notes: The look of poverty seems fairly popular in some areas. Many people choose to appear poor in order to solicit free money and items from others. NPC [[Simon the Beggar]] has this outfit. The creature [[Crazed Beggar]] also has this outfit.

body.history: This outfit was added to the [[Store]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|7236|April 14, 2023}}.
body.name: Armoured Archer
body.notes:
Armoured Archers are the epitome of invisible danger. Silently and nimbly, they advance in the background. For hours, they wait patiently, almost motionless, for the decisive moment. Just to be perfectly present in a deadly second.
[[File:Armoured_Archer_Outfits.png]]

body.name: Oriental
body.notes: This comfortable, yet fashionable outfit will create the romantic mood of thousand and one nights. A good place to look around for addons are naturally [[Darama]] and [[Ankrahmun]].

body.history:
These outfits were added to the [[Store]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|4405|December 23, 2017}}, but they were already implemented a few months earlier with [[Updates/11.45.5528|Update 11.45]].
<gallery captionalign="center" widths="300" heights="300" mode="nolines">
Client Artwork 11.50.jpg|A female Sun Priest wearing both addons is pictured in the Login Screen launched with the [[Updates/11.50|Winter Update 2017]]. 
</gallery>
[[File:Sun Priest Outfits Artwork.jpg|thumb|300px|left|Additional Photo]]
body.name: Sun Priest
body.notes: Do you worship warm temperatures and are opposed to the thought of long and dark winter nights? Do you refuse to spend countless evenings in front of your chimney while ice-cold wind whistles through the cracks and niches of your house? It is time to stop freezing and to become an honourable Sun Priest! With this stylish outfit, you can finally show the world your unconditional dedication and commitment to the sun!

body.name: Ancient Aucar
body.notes: The second addon became obtainable after the [[Winter Update 2023|Winter 2023 Update]].

body.name: Yalaharian
body.notes:
This outfit stands for a [[Yalahari]] citizen.
Although both addons of this outfit can't be unlocked at the same time by regular players, CipSoft characters can wear both addons at once as seen on the screenshots below taken from [https://www.tibia.com/abouttibia/?subtopic=screenshots Tibia.com's Screenshots section]. Also obtaining either of the addons will unlock the [[Achievements|achievement]] [[Yalahari of Wisdom]] or [[Yalahari of Power]]. Yalahar Screenshot.png|Character at the center is wearing full male Yalaharian Outfit Battle Screenshot.png|Character at the northwest corner is wearing full male Yalaharian Outfit

body.history: The outfit was added as part of a promotion by [[CipSoft]]. You can buy the outfit with no addons, one addon or the full outfit from the official Tibia website. The outfit and its addons are otherwise unobtainable in-game.
body.name: Ceremonial Garb
body.notes:
If you want to make a great entrance at a Tibian costume party, the Ceremonial Garb is certainly a good choice. With a drum over your shoulder and adorned with feathers you are perfectly dressed to lead a carnival parade through the streets of Thais.
''Full Walking Animations from Outfit Shop:'' Ceremonial_Garb_Outfit.gif|Base Outfit Ceremonial_Garb_Outfit_with_Addon_1.gif|First Addon Ceremonial_Garb_Outfit_with_Addon_2.gif|Second Addon Full_Ceremonial_Garb_Outfit.gif|Full Outfit

body.name: Forest Warden
body.notes: The Forest Warden watches over all living things in the woods, be they plants or beasts. They have a special connection to the earth they tread on, the air they breathe, and the wind which whispers around them. Naturally, the suit that they don is not made out of dead vegetation, but is a living being itself.

body.history: These outfits were added to the [[Store]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|4319|October 13, 2017}}, but they were already implemented a few months earlier with the [[Updates/11.40|Summer Update 2017]].
body.name: Herbalist
body.notes: The Herbalist outfit is the perfect outfit for all herbs collectors. Those of you who are aware that you do not necessarily have to reach into the mouth of a hydra to get a hydra tongue and those who know exactly where to get blood- and shadow-herbs will find a matching outfit for their daily hobby. Show the world your affinity for herbs and impress your friends with your knowledge of medicine and potions.

body.history: The outfit was added as part of a promotion by [[CipSoft]]. You can buy the outfit with no addons, one addon or the full outfit from the official Tibia website. The outfit and its addons are otherwise unobtainable in-game.
body.name: Puppeteer
body.notes:
Are you a fan of puppetry? You like to travel the world together with one or two little acting fellows? Or are you simply the one who likes to pull the strings? Then the Puppeteer outfit is the right choice for you.
''Full Walking Animations from Outfit Shop:'' Puppeteer_Outfit.gif|Base Outfit Puppeteer_Outfit_with_Addon_1.gif|First Addon Puppeteer_Outfit_with_Addon_2.gif|Second Addon Puppeteer_Outfit_with_Addon_3.gif|Full Outfit

body.history: This outfit was added to the [[Store]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|7855|May 17, 2024}}.
body.name: Blade Dancer
body.notes:
Embrace the Blade Dancer outfit, where grace meets might, each step a dance, each move a fight. Adorned with blades, it is not just attire, but a declaration of elegance as deadly as it is beautiful. You are the artist amidst the fray? Then this should be your choice.
[[File:Blade_Dancer_Banner.jpg]]

body.history: This outfit was added to the [[Store]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|6357|October 08, 2021}}.
body.name: Arbalester
body.notes: Armed with a powerful crossbow, and gifted with steady hands as well as a sharp eye, the Arbalester is not one to be trifled with. Requiring both skill and strength to properly wield, the arbalest is a mighty tool in the hands of an able marksman, shooting deadly bolts across great distance.

body.history: These outfits were added to the [[Store]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|4069|May 12, 2017}}, but the sprites had already been released with [[Updates/11.30|Update 11.30]].
body.name: Retro Mage
body.notes: Dress up as a Retro Mage and you will always cut a fine figure on the battleground while eliminating your enemies with your magical powers the old-fashioned way.

body.name: Shaman
body.notes: The classic "native healer" look. Shaman are known for their abilities to heal wounds with mysterious (and sometimes comical) rituals. With the shaman outfits you will certainly turn heads.

body.name: Decaying Defender
body.notes: [[File:Decaying Defender Concept.jpg|thumb|left|400px]]

body.history: Although these outfits were implemented on [[Updates/11.80|Update 11.80]], their corresponding achievement - for obtaining both addons - was only implemented on [[Updates/11.86|Update 11.86]].
body.name: Battle Mage
Citizen
body.notes: This outfit was revamped in [[Updates/7.8|Update 7.8]]. No one should be caught dead without an attractive outfit. The citizen outfits are appropriate for all persons and personalities. Understated and modest, but practical and relevant.

body.name: Demon
body.notes: Demon outfits are fit for those who casually fight demonic forces.

body.history: These outfits were added to the [[Store]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|4093|May 26, 2017}}, but the sprites had already been released with [[Updates/11.30|Update 11.30]].
body.name: Retro Summoner
body.notes: While the Retro Mage usually throws runes and mighty spells directly at the enemies, the Retro Summoner outfit might be the better choice for Tibians that prefer to send mighty summons to the battlefield to keep their enemies at distance.

body.name: Brotherhood
body.notes: Brotherhood of Bones outfits are a new design for Dread Lords.

body.history: The outfit was added as part of a promotion by [[CipSoft]]. You can buy the outfit with no addons, one addon or the full outfit from the official Tibia website.  The outfit and its addons are otherwise unobtainable in-game.
body.name: Evoker
body.notes:
Dance around flickering fires in the Evoker outfit while singing unholy chants to praise witchcraft and wizardry. Your faithful bat will always be by your side.
''Full Walking Animations from Outfit Shop:'' Evoker_Outfit.gif|Base Outfit Evoker_Outfit_with_Addon_1.gif|First Addon Evoker_Outfit_with_Addon_2.gif|Second Addon Full_Evoker_Outfit.gif|Full Outfit

body.history:
* Originally only available through [[Tournaments]], it could be purchased for 1,750 {{Icon|Tournament Coin}} [[Tournament]] Coins and it would become available for all characters of the account.
* After the {{OfficialNewsArchive|6180|Sunsetting}} of Tournaments, it became available on [[Updates/13.14.13146|March 21, 2023]] to players using 12,500 [[Tibiadrome|Drome Points]].
body.name: Lion of War
body.notes: It can be bought from one of the [[Tibiadrome NPCs]].

body.history: This outfit was added to the [[Store]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|6544|January 21, 2022}}.
body.name: Ghost Blade
body.notes: Being a Ghost Blade means having mastered the way of the warrior. No matter the circumstances, these fighters retain full control over their body and mind, with the sole focus of vanquishing their foe. So great is their ability that they not only control the weapons in their hands perfectly, but two floating blades following them as well.

body.history: These outfits were added to the [[Store]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|3687|September 16, 2016}}, but the sprites were already released with [[Updates/10.97|Update 10.97]].
body.name: Lupine Warden
body.notes: Do you feel the adrenaline rushing through your veins when the sun goes down and a full moon lightens the night? Do you have the urge to hunt down your target no matter what? Unleash the beast inside of you and lead your friends to battle with the Lupine Warden outfit!

body.name: Druid
body.notes: Nature-loving and peaceful druids might like this outfit, especially the beast-like addons. I heard that there is a druid living near Ab'Dendriel, who might be able to provide fitting addons.

body.history:
* Originally, it could be purchased for 1,750 {{Icon|Tournament Coin}} and would become available for all characters of the account.
* As of the {{OfficialNewsArchive|6180|Sunsetting}} of [[Tournaments]], on [[Updates/13.14.13146|March 21, 2023]] it became available to players using [[Tibia Coins]].
body.name: Void Master
body.notes: According to ancient rumours, the pulsating orb that the Void Master balances skilfully on the tip of his staff consists of powerful cosmic spheres. If you gaze too long into the infinite emptiness inside the orb, its powers will absorb your mind.

body.history: The outfit was added as part of a promotion by [[CipSoft]]. You can buy the outfit with no addons, one addon or the full outfit from the official Tibia website.  The outfit and its addons are otherwise unobtainable in-game.
body.name: Seaweaver
body.notes:
The Seaweaver outfit is the perfect choice if you want to show the world that you are indeed a son or a daughter of the submarine kingdom. You can almost feel the salty taste and the rough wind of the sea when wearing it.
''Full Walking Animations from Outfit Shop:'' Seaweaver_Outfit.gif|Base Outfit Seaweaver_Outfit_with_Addon_1.gif|First Addon Seaweaver_Outfit_with_Addon_2.gif|Second Addon Full_Seaweaver_Outfit.gif|Full Outfit

body.history: These outfits were added to the [[Store]] on July 15, 2016, but the sprites were already released with [[Updates/10.94|Update 10.94]], the update which also implemented the [[Monster Arena]]s which these outfits relate to.
body.name: Arena Champion
body.notes: Fight your bloody battles in the arena and become a darling of the crowd. Once you have made it to the top and everyone is cheering your name, the fashionable outfit of an Arena Champion will show the world what you are made of.

body.history:
This outfit and addons could be obtained through a {{OfficialNewsArchive|1965|special offer from CipSoft}} to those players who bought 90, 180, or 360 days worth of premium time from February 1st until February 15th, 2012. For the '''basic outfit''' - 90 days, '''basic with addon 1''' - 180 days, and '''full outfit''' - 360 days.

They have been available in the [[Store]] since {{OfficialNewsArchive|4167|July 14, 2017}}.
body.name: Entrepreneur
body.notes: Slaughter through hordes of monsters during your early morning hunt and kiss the hand of Queen Eloise later on at the evening reception in her historical residence. With the Entrepreneur outfit you will cut a fine figure on every occasion.

body.history:
* Originally, it could be acquired for 5000 {{Icon|Tournament Coin}} if you placed in the top 3 of a [[Tournament]], and it would grant access to all characters on the account. 
* Since the {{OfficialNewsArchive|6180|Sunsetting}} of [[Tournaments]] it became temporarily unavailable from {{OfficialNewsArchive|7582|March 17, 2023}} up until the update which was released on {{OfficialNewsArchive|7582|October 10th, 2023}}. Since then it has been reintroduced into the game through the addition of [[Nimmersatt's Lair]], as was previously mentioned would be done in the news {{OfficialNewsArchive|7200|here}}.
body.name: Dragon Slayer
body.notes: The souls of countless slain dragons have been fused over the years with this armour, wrought from the impervious scales of the ancestors of those very same beings, wicked and wise, winged and wild. The Dragon Slayer Outfit has seen an unfathomable amount of bloodshed, but it pales in comparison to the untold lives lost in the strife over the armour itself. Only the mightiest warriors can even begin to dream of ever owning this exceedingly rare token of power.

body.name: Necromancer
body.notes: The Necromancer walks the darkest paths, where light has long been forgotten. Without blood to warm their veins and void of all mortal stirrings, they are the shadow of a cold dream. Wrapping icy fingers around the throats of the weak, leaving only stillness behind.

body.history: The outfit was added as part of a promotion by [[CipSoft]]. You can buy the outfit with no addons, one addon or the full outfit from the official Tibia website. The outfit and its addons are otherwise unobtainable in-game.
body.name: Beastmaster
body.notes:
Do you have enough authority to make wild animals subservient to you? Become a Beastmaster and surround yourself with fearsome companions. When your beasts bare their teeth, your enemies will turn tails and run.
''Full Walking Animations from Outfit Shop:'' Beastmaster_Outfit.gif|Base Outfit Beastmaster_Outfit_with_Addon_1.gif|First Addon Beastmaster_Outfit_with_Addon_2.gif|Second Addon Full_Beastmaster_Outfit.gif|Full Outfit

body.name: Golden
body.notes:
Shining brightly against the darkness, the legendary golden outfit illuminates the path towards glory and grandeur. Radiating unique magnificence and extravagance, those of royal blood will award it only to the most prestigious and prosperous Tibians in exchange for a generous donation.

Unlike other quest outfits, these outfits can be obtained and worn by [[Free Account]] players.

You can see the players who own the Golden Outfit in a given server by checking a [[Memorial]].

An unofficial list of all confirmed [[Golden Outfits]] owners can be found in {{Thread|4739113|this thread}}.

body.name: Cave Explorer
body.notes: If you are an explorer, this outfit is fit for you.

body.history: It was added to the [[Store]] on March 14, 2016.
body.name: Philosopher
body.notes: Do you feel the urge to tell people what is really going on in the world? Do you know all answers to the important questions of life? Are you a true philosopher? Then dress like one to showcase the latest fashion for all wise theorists.

body.name: Newly Wed
body.notes:
To dress yourself with the wedding outfit, you need to get through the [[wedding]] ceremony.
The Newly Wed Outfits are unique in that you don't need to complete [[Quests]] to get them, rather you need to [[Marriage|get married]].
This outfit is also available to free accounts, but has no [[addon]]s. [[Rooking]] yourself will not rid you of the outfit.

The female version of this outfit is wide enough to hide a [[bag]] when standing on it. This may be useful to hide [[lootbags]].

body.history: This outfit was added to the [[Store]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|6225|July 09, 2021}}.
body.name: Dragon Knight
body.notes: A Dragon Knight is ready for everything, channeling the primordial might of the winged, ancient beasts into weapons and armour. Their imposing demeanour and impressive appearance are often enough to quell any animosity towards them, and those who still dare oppose them are not long for this world.

body.history: This outfit was added to the [[Store]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|6808|July 08, 2022}}.
body.name: Fencer
body.notes: They are skilled, they are disciplined, they wield their weapon with deadly precision as a form of art. Fencers are true masters of the blade who can cut through anything and anyone in the blink of an eye. While being feared for their lethal attacks, they are also admired for their elegant and fierce style, their dashing looks. Do not be on the fence, be a fencer, or at least dress like one with this fashionable, cutting-edge outfit.

body.name: Herder
body.notes: The Herder is one with nature, being outside all day, watching carefully over his flock. If you like to spend time on picturesque meadows and are always looking for greener pastures, then this outfit is for you.

body.history: It is part of the [[Rotten Blood Bundle]]. This outfit was added to the [[Store]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|7386|July 10, 2023}}.
body.name: Darklight Evoker
body.notes: To those intrepid souls who ventured unafraid through the depths of hell, emerging as victors of their own fears. For those who dared to confront the most harrowing of horrors, a tribute is offered. O' you who unearthed radiant beams amidst the shrouded darkness, you are the valiant masters of the abyss.

body.history: These outfits were added to the [[Store]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|4093|May 26, 2017}}, but the sprites had already been released with [[Updates/11.30|Update 11.30]].
body.name: Retro Nobleman
body.notes: King Tibianus has invited you to a summer ball and you have nothing to wear for this special event? Do not worry, the Retro Noble(wo)man outfit makes you a real eye catcher on every festive occasion.

body.history: These outfits were added to the [[Store]] on {{OfficialNewsArchive|4069|May 12, 2017}}, but the sprites had already been released with [[Updates/11.30|Update 11.30]].
body.name: Retro Knight
body.notes: Who needs a fancy looking sword with bling-bling and ornaments? Back in the days, we survived without such unnecessary accessories! Time to show those younkers what a Retro Knight is made of.

body.name: Fiend Slayer
body.outfit: [[Premium Account]], see [[No Rest for the Wicked Quest]]

body.history:
* Originally, it could be purchased for 1,750 {{Icon|Tournament Coin}} and would be available for all characters of the account.
* As of the {{OfficialNewsArchive|6180|Sunsetting}} of [[Tournaments]], on [[Updates/13.14.13146|March 21, 2023]] it became available using [[Tibia Coins]].
body.name: Veteran Paladin
body.notes: A Veteran Paladin has mastered the art of distance fighting. No matter how far away his prey may be, a marksman like the Veteran Paladin will always hit with extraordinary precision. No one can escape his keen hawk-eyed vision and even small stones become deadly weapons in his hands.
